title: Fixed Raised Spring Puppet Crank Box
description: One newly authored complete fixed raised spring-puppet toy-box appearance. A deep whole red case has a true open cavity, floor and walls, with a recessed lid fixed back on hinge pins and stays. One continuous 5.5-turn closed helical spring joins the inner floor mount to a full flared puppet torso and neck. A new closed rounded toy head, simple blank eyes, round nose and conical cap are permanently attached above it. A through-bearing side shaft and crank grip are fixed on the case. No old bird rider body or saddle, no music-box pinned drum or comb and no shape-sorter pieces are imported: the complete deep-box/raised-coil/puppet exterior is independently authored, counted as one toy not separate character or spring assets. Three opaque constant untextured PBR roles; metres, Z up, whole horizontally centred finite ground sole. One model and zero scenes. Static nonfunctional art only: no concealed gearing, catch or release, stored energy, actual popping, cranking, spring motion, surprise effect, age suitability, pinch or swallowing protection, toy certification, fabrication or safety claim.
